scenario: A newsroom journalist receives a city council meeting transcript and runs a three-skill pipeline to audit it for accuracy: first NLP-analyze all council member statements for linguistic quality signals, then verify any flagged statements against professional fact-checking databases, then generate a structured correction memo for publication.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyzes each council member statement and annotates it with linguistic quality metrics → verify-claims receives the annotated statements and verifies those tagged as requiring attention against fact-checker databases → reporting assembles a correction memo from the verification verdicts.
